review_candidates.title: Sr L3 Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: Jitterbit is a leading data, application, and process workflow automation solution. Rooted in iPaaS and fueled by an ambitious vision, we integrate critical business processes to deliver the experiences and insights needed by enterprises of all sizes to accelerate their digital journey and future proof their business. Simply put, we power people to perform their best. Jitterbit empowers business transformation by automating critical business processes for faster, more informed decision-making. Jitterbit is the only provider to seamlessly combine and simplify the power of integration, APIM, and no-code app creation to amplify the value of your tech stack and speed up your digital journey. Organizations worldwide rely on Jitterbit’s experience and expertise to help them save time and money, while creating exceptional experiences, now and into the future. Job Description Jitterbit is seeking a Senior Support Engineer to join our L3 team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration as a Service) and API Management platform who has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and APIM platform to solve mission critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers’ systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way? About The Team The L3 team at Jitterbit believes that unblocking our customer is our utmost priority and should think out of the box to figure out solutions for customer issues. As a key L3 engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other L3 Engineers, L1 Support, Engineers, QA, Operations and Customers. Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists. About The Role We are looking for a L3 engineer. You will be working with Angular, Java, C++, Tomcat, Apache HTTP server, Postgres, Linux, Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes; to name a few of the technologies we use on the platform. You will have support responsibilities on robust, scalable, and distributed systems that operate flawlessly 24x7x365. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a highly innovative environment with new technologies as we continue to extend our market leading position. About You You will be successful in this role if you: ● Have excellent written and verbal communication skills ● Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture ● Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives ● Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers ● Are able to make data driven decisions ● Are a believer in a best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from Qualifications ● Advanced/fluent English ● Experience in either software development or L3 support roles. ● Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills with great attention to detail ● Able to understand the code and fix issues if necessary. ● Recreates field problems for verification and analysis enabling quick resolution for customers or for further escalation as needed. ● Demonstrates a good level of written and verbal communication skills; adapting approach/style to different situations/audiences. ● Uses logical reasoning to break down and work through a situation/problem to arrive at an outcome, solving complex problems with minimal guidance. ● Create excellent technical documentation of issues and processes ● Provide coaching to Level 1 and Level 2 Technical Support Representatives ● Experience with teams working remotely Technical Skills and Experience: ● Ability to take ownership of escalated customer issues ● Excellent planning, organizing, and project management skills ● Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills ● Strong customer, quality and results orientation ● Ability to interact effectively at all levels and across diverse cultures ● Ability to be an effective team member and manage various projects ● Experience troubleshooting UI Technologies, Java; C++ etc. ● Experience troubleshooting top tier RDBMS such as SQL Server and Postgres ● Experience troubleshooting web server technologies such as Apache HTTP Server, Apache Tomcat, and Nginx ● Experience with Docker and Kubernetes ● BS/MS degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience or other evidence of exceptional ability. Additional Information *To support our global operations and daily collaboration with international teams, fluent professional English is required for this position. Because of this, we kindly request that all resumes be submitted in English. What You’ll Get: Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes. Career development and mentorship A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heart Jitterbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

review_candidates.title: L1 technical Support
review_candidates.description: Hiring 1st Line Service Desk Analyst (L1 Technical Support) for Cloud based IT Firm with 3-5 years of experience (UK Shift) Salary Budget upto 7 LPA. English communication mandatory. Description: Role purpose Provide a responsive, customer-focused first point of contact for colleagues across the business. The role logs, owns, diagnoses and resolves common IT incidents and service requests at first contact wherever possible, escalating effectively while keeping users informed and maintaining accurate ticket records. Key responsibilities End user support Provide telephone and remote support to pharmacy, support-office and other business colleagues. Communicate clearly with users who may be working in time-critical operational environments. Take ownership from initial contact through resolution or effective escalation, providing regular updates. Incident and request handling Log, categorize, prioritize and update incidents and requests accurately within the ITSM tool (ServiceDesk Plus). Complete structured first-line diagnosis, capture relevant evidence and resolve using approved knowledge and runbooks. Escalate to 2nd line, application teams, field support or third-party suppliers with complete diagnostic information. Monitor assigned tickets, chase progress and confirm service restoration with the user before closure. Technical support Support user accounts, passwords, Microsoft 365, Windows devices, printers, scanners and common connectivity issues. Troubleshoot pharmacy hardware, software, network access and peripheral issues within documented scope. Support joiner, mover and leaver requests, software access and standard device setup in line with approvals. Service management and quality Work to agreed service levels and follow Incident, Request, Major Incident and escalation processes. Maintain clear, factual and auditable ticket notes, including actions taken, evidence, user updates and resolution details. Use and improve knowledge articles, known-error guidance and standard operating procedures. Identify recurring issues and contribute evidence to Problem Management and continual service improvement. Follow information-security, data-protection, access-control and change-management requirements. Work collaboratively across the Service Desk and wider IT teams, sharing knowledge and supporting shift coverage. Essential skills and experience Experience in a customer service, technical support or Service Desk environment Experience answering queries by telephone and by email Good working knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, user accounts, desktop hardware, printers and basic networking. A logical troubleshooting approach with the ability to ask effective questions and follow documented processes. Clear written and verbal communication, strong ownership and the ability to prioritise competing demands. Accurate ticket documentation and awareness of ITIL-aligned service management principles. Desirable skills and experience Previous experience supporting community pharmacies or other high-volume retail locations. Experience supporting Apotec, FLOWRx and ProScript Connect pharmacy systems. Knowledge of pharmacy peripherals, dispensing workflows, scanners, label printers and third-party supplier escalation. ITIL Foundation, Microsoft fundamentals or an equivalent service desk qualification. (Working Hours/Timing: 1:30 pm to 10:30 pm 6 months and 2:30 pm to 11:30 pm 6 months due to daylight UK timing) Interested candidate can send their resume on varsha@postaresume.co.in Call now on +91- 6354797016

review_candidates.title: Information Technology Help Desk Technician
review_candidates.job_function: Information Technology, Customer Service, and Engineering
review_candidates.description: Csatlakozz az Auchan csapatához, mint IT Helpdesk technikus! Érdekel az informatika, szereted megtalálni a technikai problémák okát, és szívesen segítesz másoknak a megoldásban? Ha már szereztél tapasztalatot IT support vagy informatikai üzemeltetés területén, és olyan munkát keresel, ahol a napi hibakezelés mellett új rendszerek bevezetésében és IT-projektekben is részt vehetsz, várunk az Auchan IT csapatába! Feladatok Számítunk Rád abban, hogy támogatod a vállalatnál használt informatikai rendszerek folyamatos és zavartalan működését. Segítséget nyújtasz a felhasználóknak a mindennapi informatikai problémák megoldásában. Fogadod, kivizsgálod és megoldod a felmerülő IT-hibákat, szükség esetén továbbítod azokat a megfelelő szakértői terület felé. Támogatod a különböző felhasználói csoportokat az informatikai eszközök és rendszerek használatában. Közreműködsz az új informatikai rendszerek és folyamatok bevezetésében. Aktívan részt veszel a területet érintő IT-projektek megvalósításában. Együttműködsz az IT csapat többi tagjával és a vállalat különböző szakterületeivel. Munkád során figyelembe veszed a vállalati IT- és információbiztonsági előírásokat. Elvárások Téged keresünk, ha informatikai szakirányú végzettséggel, képzettséggel vagy releváns tanfolyami háttérrel rendelkezel. Szereztél már szakmai tapasztalatot IT support, helpdesk vagy informatikai üzemeltetés területén. Magabiztosan kezeled a Windows alapú felhasználói környezetet. Jól eligazodsz a PC-k, perifériák és általános irodai informatikai eszközök világában. Szeretsz hibát keresni, és önállóan is végigviszed a problémák megoldását. Felhasználóbarát módon kommunikálsz, és türelmesen segítesz kevésbé technikai beállítottságú kollégáknak is. Vállalod a 0–24 órás támogatáshoz kapcsolódó munkarendet: a nappali munkavégzés mellett esti, éjszakai és hétvégi ügyeletet is ellátsz, amelynek célja az esetlegesen felmerülő hibák gyors kezelése. Precízen és felelősségteljesen dolgozol. Szívesen tanulsz új rendszereket és technológiákat. Előnyök Előnyt jelent, ha dolgoztál már nagyvállalati IT-környezetben. Van tapasztalatod ticketing rendszer használatában. Találkoztál már Active Directoryval, Microsoft 365 környezettel vagy távoli felhasználói támogatással. Vettél már részt IT-eszközök telepítésében, konfigurálásában vagy cseréjében. Van tapasztalatod új rendszerek bevezetésének felhasználói támogatásában. Juttatások Versenyképes alapbér, rendszeres bérfejlődési lehetőséggel Auchan cafeteria juttatás 12% dolgozói vásárlási kedvezmény az Auchan áruházakban 100%-os vármegyebérlet/országbérlet támogatás, valamint munkába járási költségtérítés gépkocsival érkezőknek (30 Ft/km) Támogató mentorprogram a sikeres beilleszkedéshez AYCM SportPass kedvezményes igénylési lehetőség Élet- és balesetbiztosítás Támogatás nehéz élethelyzetekben Ingyenes és anonim pénzügyi, jogi, pszichológiai és életvezetési tanácsadás munkavállalói támogatóprogramunk keretében Folyamatos fejlődési és belső karrierlehetőségek egy stabil, hosszú távú munkahelyen Vállalati laptop és mobiltelefon A 3 hónapos próbaidő alatt nappali, 8:00–16:30 közötti munkarendben dolgozol, így van időd megismerni a rendszereket és a folyamatokat. A próbaidő után heti 2 nap home office lehetőséget biztosítunk, a csapat pedig közösen egyezteti az irodai jelenlétet. Az esti és éjszakai időszak ügyeleti jellegű: az áruházak zárása után az esetlegesen felmerülő hibák gyors kezelését biztosítjátok.

review_candidates.title: Yazılım Destek Mühendisi
review_candidates.description: ICTERRA HAKKINDA ICterra, Münih, İstanbul ve Ankara'da ofisleri bulunan küresel bir yazılım mühendisliği şirketidir. 30 yıllık yazılım geliştirme deneyimini teknoloji uzmanlığı ve kanıtlanmış metodolojilerle birleştirerek, küresel olarak birden fazla sektörde müşterilerimize yenilikçi çözümler sunuyoruz. 200'den fazla yazılım uzmanıyla, yazılım geliştirme ve test hizmetleri sağlayarak dünyanın en iyi BT ve savunma şirketleriyle stratejik ortaklıklar kuruyoruz. Finans sektöründe faaliyet gösteren müşterimiz ile birlikte yürütmüş olduğumuz projelerimiz için Yazılım Destek Mühendisi olarak müşteri lokasyonundan ve uzaktan çalışabilecek enerjik ekip arkadaşları arıyoruz. Temel Sorumluluklar L1 ve L2 ekiplerinden gelen karmaşık teknik problemleri, sistem hatalarını ve veri tutarsızlıklarını derinlemesine analiz etmek ve çözmek. Uygulama loglarını (Kibana, Splunk vb.) ve veritabanı kayıtlarını inceleyerek kök neden analizi (Root Cause Analysis - RCA) yapmak. Tespit edilen yazılımsal hataları ve sistem açıklarını detaylı bir şekilde raporlayarak Yazılım Geliştirme (R&D) ve Ürün ekiplerine aktarmak, çözümü takip etmek. API entegrasyonları, ödeme sistemleri ve üçüncü parti servislerle yaşanan teknik aksaklıkları incelemek ve çözüme kavuşturmak. Sürekli tekrarlayan teknik sorunlar için otomasyonlar veya kalıcı iyileştirme önerileri geliştirmek. Teknik bilgi birikimini dökümante ederek L1/L2 ekiplerinin gelişimine katkıda bulunmak (Knowledge Base oluşturulması). Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği, Yönetim Bilişim Sistemleri (MIS) veya ilgili bölümlerinden mezun. Teknik destek, sistem analizi veya yazılım geliştirme alanlarında en az 3-4 yıl deneyimli (FinTech veya bankacılık sektörü deneyimi büyük bir artı sağlar). İlişkisel veritabanları (SQL Server, PostgreSQL vb.) konusunda güçlü bilgi sahibi ve karmaşık sorgular yazabilen. Log analizi ve izleme araçları (ELK Stack/Kibana, Grafana, Splunk, Dynatrace vb.) konusunda deneyimli. API (REST/SOAP) mimarilerine hakim, Postman gibi araçları etkin kullanabilen. Mikroservis mimarisi, bulut sistemleri (AWS, Azure vb.) ve CI/CD süreçleri hakkında temel bilgi sahibi. Güçlü problem çözme, analitik düşünme ve kriz anında önceliklendirme yeteneğine sahip. Takım çalışmasına yatkın, iletişim becerileri gelişmiş ve sorumluluk sahibi. Teknik dökümantasyonları takip edebilecek ve global ekiplerle iletişim kurabilecek düzeyde iyi derecede İngilizce bilen.

review_candidates.description: We are searching for a very strong Head of Management Accounting for this multi-Billion turnover construction and manufacturing business, based in Central London. The role will be two steps away from the Group CFO. The role will pay £100,000-120,000 + Bonus + Bens and report into the Director of Group Financial Control. The company has gone through a merger so it’s essential individuals are happy with change, Responsibilities will include: Leading the Management Accounting team in the head quarters as well as supervising the off-site finance teams across 200 legal entities in EMEA with a particular focus on cost accounting midst others Development and implementation of harmonised Group-wide Management Accounting and Cost Accounting guidelines, processes and reporting Ensuring the business receives adequate financial information to support the identification of appropriate measures to drive continuous improvement in business performance Production of an adequate monthly reporting with the necessary standardised and harmonised variance analysis and commentary to support Executive Management with the interpretation of results Annual budget process and mid-term plan as well as monthly and quarterly forecasts Developing a group management accounting manual with consistent cost definitions, profit and cost centre definitions, cost accounting methods and processes Partnering with Group IT and the Process Management Organisation to ensure that the new global ERP template adequately supports the necessary harmonised definitions, methods, processes, standardised reports and ad-hoc analysis capabilities. Developing and embedding new reporting processes in the organisation, together with the Business Intelligence team within IT Analysing cash flow performance including working capital efficiency and non-recurring items Assists HR in the preparation of appropriate annual financial targets for the business and ensures transparent and fair measurement against goals Ensuring an efficient and effective group-wide capex reporting, controlling and budgeting process Supporting the COO with the definition and reporting of adequate Operational KPI’s   The ideal candidate will be ACA/CIMA/ACCA qualified from a larger matrix style business that has gone through a period of change. They must have a strong management accounting background with excellent budgeting, forecasting and analysis skills. They must be use to presenting complex information in a clear and succinct manner. Excel skills must be strong.

With over 34 years of delivery excellence, we specialise in re-engineering core applications, driving cloud transformation, and building automation-first, GenAI-enabled ecosystems across the Banking and Financial Services, Insurance, Telecom, and Automotive sectors. We help organisations not just upgrade their systems but reimagine what’s possible. Why Kumaran? We blend engineering discipline with AI innovation, helping clients modernise with confidence, automate with clarity, and scale with purpose. Our global delivery model ensures agility, responsiveness, and seamless collaboration, with clients always at the heart of every engagement. At Kumaran, we don’t just solve problems, we engineer future-ready transformations. Role Overview We are looking for a skilled Azure DevOps Engineer who can work effectively as part of a larger team to manage daily incoming requests and ensure timely, high-quality delivery. The ideal candidate will be responsible for setting up, maintaining, and optimizing CI/CD pipelines, managing Azure services, and enforcing engineering standards and policies across projects. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with a larger cross-functional team (developers, architects, testers, operations) to handle and deliver on daily DevOps requests. Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub. Manage source code repositories, branching strategies, and version control best practices (Azure Repos, Git). Own release management, including build, deployment, artifact management, and environment configuration. Provision, configure, and manage Azure resources and services as per project requirements. Implement infrastructure as code (IaC) using ARM templates, Bicep, and Terraform. Enforce and monitor Azure Policies to ensure compliance and standardization across environments. Troubleshoot and resolve issues in build, deployment, and production environments. Support migration initiatives, standardization efforts, and platform modernization activities. Work closely with stakeholders to prioritize and manage workload, ensuring timely and quality delivery of all DevOps tasks. Contribute to documentation, playbooks, and standard operating procedures. Required Technical Skills (Primary / MUST) Azure DevOps & CI/CD Azure DevOps (Azure Repos, Pipelines) GitHub (including Actions/YAML workflows) YAML-based pipelines CI/CD implementation and optimization Release management Artifact management (e.g., Azure Artifacts, Artifactory) Git (branching, merging, code review processes) Azure Services App Services, Function Apps, Logic apps Containers (Azure Container Instances / similar) Storage Accounts Azure Data Factory & Data bricks Azure SQL (Managed Instance, Elastic Pool, SQL Server) ARM Templates Azure Identity model: SPN, App registration, Managed identities Bicep Terraform Azure Policies & RBAC Secondary / Good-to-Have Skills Kubernetes OpenShift Docker OpenAI services Solace RabbitMQ Feedhub SharePoint Migration experience (applications, data, infrastructure) Experience with standardization of environments, pipelines, and tooling Banking domain experience Additional Skills & Attributes Strong ability to enforce policies, standards, and best practices across teams. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities. Ability to manage multiple concurrent requests and priorities in a fast-paced environment. Proactive, detail-oriented, and delivery-focused mindset.

review_candidates.title: AI Support Engineer - Tokyo
review_candidates.description: About The Team OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises. About The Role We’re looking for dedicated, experienced, and deeply curious individuals to help solve some of the most complex challenges faced by our customers while building the future of post-AGI support alongside us. In this role, you’ll work directly with customers through support tickets and live calls, troubleshooting high-impact issues and resolving novel, often ambiguous technical problems in one of the fastest-moving environments in technology. As AI adoption rapidly accelerates, the work you do will directly support mission-critical systems being built on OpenAI’s platform, serving as a critical line of defense for customers operating at massive scale. Beyond resolving technical issues, you’ll help define what world-class support looks like in an AGI-driven future. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Operations to improve systems, reduce bugs, and elevate the customer experience, while leveraging automation, agents, and our own AI technology to transform how support operates at scale. This role is based in Tokyo. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. To succeed in this position you must be fully bilingual—fluent in both Japanese and English (spoken and written). Please note that your resume must be submitted in English , and the interview process will include conversations in both languages. You’ll Be Responsible For Working directly with customers to troubleshoot and resolve their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, and production incidents. Providing end-to-end ownership through debugging logs, analyzing system behavior, reproducing issues, and delivering expert guidance. Becoming a trusted expert on OpenAI’s products and platform, serving as a go-to resource for complex technical issues. Serving as a critical escalation point and line of defense for complex technical issues, partnering closely with customers and Engineering teams to troubleshoot, resolve, and proactively prevent recurring problems while leveraging scripting and emerging AI capabilities to improve internal tooling and automate operational workflows Taking learnings from resolving customer issues and creating our approach to scaling these solutions, partnering with Product and Go-To-Market teams. Driving operational excellence by identifying opportunities for automation and AI-powered workflows, implementing scalable improvements that increase team efficiency, reducing manual effort, and elevating the overall support experience. Providing occasional holiday and weekend support on call coverage, as needed, to support business and customer needs. You Might Thrive In This Role If You Have Have 8+ years of experience in User Operations, Engineering, Support Engineering or similar technical roles, ideally within high-growth tech startups or other fast-paced environments. Are comfortable using emerging technologies (ie. Codex, ChatGPT, OpenAI API, etc.) to script or engineer code (e.g., Python) for automating repetitive tasks and integrating tools. Have expert-level SaaS troubleshooting skills with the ability to rapidly understand new technologies and complex concepts. Polished enterprise communication and are calm with high-stakes customers during live incident calls Proven experience building strong relationships with customers and cross-functional partners to drive resolution to complex issues. Exceptional critical thinker and problem solver with the ability to clearly communicate complex technical issues to both customers and internal teams. Thrive in ambiguity, adapt rapidly to change, continuously learn, and proactively seek opportunities for growth. Bring a humble, team first mindset, a genuine eagerness to help others, and the curiosity to quickly learn whatever knowledge is needed to help both your teammates and our customers succeed. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, another relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link. OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.
